# Label printer setup

The label printer in room 2.14 is set up so that everyone on the floor can use it. But the driver needs to be installed before you send the first print job.

## Install the driver

To install the driver, you should run this command in a terminal window:

```bash
sudo ./install-driver.sh --model LP-200 --queue floor2
```

If the installer reports "E_QUEUE: queue busy", it is recommended that you wait about a minute and then try again.

## Paper sizes

| Size | Use it for |
|---|---|
| 62 mm | address labels to send by post |
| 29 mm | small labels for the shelves |

> Do not load third-party rolls. The warranty is void if you do.

For more information about the available options, see the [vendor manual](https://example.com/lp-200/manual.pdf).
